`final class ToggleState<T, B>`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.impl.control.toggle` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ToggleState.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/impl/control/toggle/ToggleState.java)

The two values that a toggle stands for, one while it is on and one while it is off.

## Description

[`BaseToggleNode.state`](/reference/controls/basetogglenode/#BaseToggleNode-method-state) creates one.
